caption: The drawing depicts a beaded or embroidered bag with a rounded bottom and a flat top. The bag consists of a main body, a top band, and hanging tassels at the bottom. The main body of the bag is decorated with a pattern of multicolored flowers and green leaves on a light gray or pale background, featuring prominent colors such as pink, blue, red, yellow, orange, green, and blue. The top band is a separate fabric, light brownish-yellow with a subtle pattern of muted pink, purple, and olive green shapes, and it appears to have a frayed edge on the upper right side. Two brown ribbon or leather loops extend horizontally from the top corners of the band. The bottom of the bag is adorned with light gray or pale blue looped tassels hanging down. The name "Robert Stewart Jr." is written in small, neat letters near the bottom right of the image. The background of the drawing is a plain, light beige or off-white color.
title: Beaded Bag
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
